dialogue.text: Yooo! BLRY in the house! Long time no see, guys!
PJ! OJ! It's so good to see you both! We've missed you!
Woah... the whole crew's back together. That's pretty cool.
You know it! Babe, check it, the man himself! Still rockin' the ol' war bucket, I see!
The... 'war bucket'? I thought we agreed it was a 'tactical pail'.
It's a legendary artifact! A symbol of our struggle! A beacon of... bucket-ness!
Whatever you say, BucketBoy! Still looks like a bucket to me!
Alright, alright! Enough about the drip! You still got that fire, PJ? Been way too long since we jammed!
You know I do, BB! Step up, let's see if you can still hang!
